plain_statement.en: New route · V17 · Extend the top contiguous coverage by 4096 evens down to [10^316-32768, 10^316-24576)

brief.zh: 与 V11–V13 的证书拼接后，把 [10^316-32768, 10^316) 内全部偶数用大素数锚与小素数见证覆盖。对 i=12289..16384 令 n=10^316-2i，取 33 个已核验偏移与 5 个新偏移 t，使 10^316-t 与 t-2i 均为素数并回放全部素性证书；小素数用不超过 211 的试除积核验。属于第四章“已经取得全段证明或具体见证的子域交接”。
brief.en: Together with V11-V13 this covers every even n in [10^316-32768, 10^316) with large-prime anchors and small-prime witnesses. For i=12289..16384 write n=10^316-2i and choose 33 verified offsets plus 5 fresh offsets t such that both 10^316-t and t-2i are prime, replaying all primality certificates; small primes are checked against the product of primes up to 211. This is a witnessed subdomain handoff in the sense of section 4.
